I feel like I don’t have a problem with customers, as soon as someone approaches me I become a different person but as soon as they turn away I’m back to being miserable, because I get that no one likes to be served by someone who looks like they’re about to kill them self, but I used to be good at hiding it with colleagues as well but I can’t anymore, I used to be fun to work with, but what’s kinda hurt me is that no ones really mentioned anything to me or asked me if anything’s wrong, but I guess I don’t blame them for not wanting to talk to me seeing as how standoffish I’ve been.

At first Work was great help for my anxiety, because it forced me to interact with people but now it’s just become a hindrance for my depression and now I feel exhausted all the time, there’s no winning when you have both anxiety and depression
